description: This file contains the implementation of the Git bisect utility, including functions for setup, execution, stepping, and cleanup of the bisect process. It manages the state of commits, references, and merge bases to automate the identification of problematic commits via binary search.

methods.name: int count_distance(struct commit_list * entry)
methods.description: Counts the distance in commits from a commit list, used to estimate how far certain commits are from each other in the history graph.

methods.name: void clear_distance(struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Resets the flags used during distance calculations on commit lists.

methods.name: void find_bisection(struct commit_list ** commit_list,int * reaches,int * all,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Finds the optimal commit to bisect, based on the current commit list and weights.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * do_find_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr,int * weights,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Performs the core algorithm to determine the split point in the commit list.

methods.name: int register_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Registers references related to bisect, such as good, bad, and skip refs.

methods.name: int read_bisect_refs(void)
methods.description: Reads bisect-related refs from the repository.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Reads the list of paths involved in the bisect process from files.

methods.name: char * join_oid_array_hex(struct oid_array * array,char delim)
methods.description: Joins an array of object IDs into a hex string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * filter_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried,int show_all,int * count,int * skipped_first)
methods.description: Filters out skipped commits from a list, optionally skipping away some commits based on a pseudo-random selection.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * managed_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried)
methods.description: Filters out skipped commits, possibly skipping away some commits based on configuration.

methods.name: void bisect_rev_setup(struct repository * r,struct rev_info * revs,struct strvec * rev_argv,const char * prefix,const char * bad_format,const char * good_format,int read_paths)
methods.description: Initializes revisions for the bisect process, setting up the scope of commits.

methods.name: void bisect_common(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Prepares the revision information for bisecting.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error error_if_skipped_commits(struct commit_list * tried,const struct object_id * bad)
methods.description: Checks if only skipped commits are left and reports an error.

methods.name: int is_expected_rev(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks whether a given revision matches the expected revision from a stored reference.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_checkout(const struct object_id * bisect_rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks out a specific commit in the repository as part of the bisect process.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object from a repository given an object ID.

methods.name: struct:commit ** get_bad_and_good_commits(struct repository * r,size_t * rev_nr)
methods.description: Constructs an array of commit objects for the current bad revision and all known good revisions.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error handle_bad_merge_base(void)
methods.description: Handles the scenario when the merge base is identified as a bad revision.

methods.name: void handle_skipped_merge_base(const struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Handles a merge base that should be skipped during bisecting.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_merge_bases(size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks the merge bases between revisions to ensure they are suitable for bisecting.

methods.name: int check_ancestors(struct repository * r,size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Verifies whether all revisions are ancestors of the bad revision.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad(struct repository * r,const char * prefix,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Ensures all good revisions are ancestors of the bad revision, possibly checking merge bases.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Displays a commit's information to the user.

methods.name: void read_bisect_terms(char ** read_bad,char ** read_good)
methods.description: Reads the terms used for describing 'bad' and 'good' revisions in the bisect session.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next_all(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs the next step of the bisect process, selecting the next revision to test.

methods.name: int estimate_bisect_steps(int all)
methods.description: Estimates the number of remaining bisect steps based on the total number of revisions.

methods.name: int mark_for_removal(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Marks references for removal during cleanup of bisect state.

methods.name: int bisect_clean_state(void)
methods.description: Cleans up all bisect-related state and references, preparing for a new bisect session.
